verdict.rationale: llama.cpp runs headlessly through terminal commands: `llama cli` for interactive or one-off inference and `llama serve` for an HTTP server. The web UI is optional, layered on top of the server. Docker images, prebuilt binaries and a dependency-free C/C++ build make server deployment straightforward, and community users confirm running it from the CLI (e.g. llama-mtmd-cli). missing for 10: explicit documentation or examples of use in CI pipelines, in-depth docs on headless server configuration and daemonization.
